label: FAM131B::BRAF

sections.text: FAM131B encodes a protein whose normal biological function remains incompletely characterized.
BRAF encodes a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway.

The rearrangement removes BRAF amino-terminal autoinhibitory regions while retaining its kinase, producing constitutive MAPK signaling. FAM131B::BRAF arises through an interstitial 7q34 deletion and is a rarer pilocytic astrocytoma driver.

Tovorafenib is US-approved for relapsed or refractory pediatric low-grade glioma with a BRAF fusion or rearrangement from age 6 months. BRAF V600-selective inhibitor activity cannot be assumed for these dimeric fusions, which can show paradoxical MAPK activation.
